findings.title: AC-dm-44 manual network check from another computer
findings.detail: The AC-dm-44 evidence is a manual smoke from a second computer on the same network. scripts/smoke-boot.mjs covers the same property from this machine by connecting to every external IPv4 address of the host (3 found) on both ports and requiring ECONNREFUSED, but a probe from a different computer was not run here.

findings.title: Dev-link in the AIOSON Play (Settings > Instalar App > Linkar pasta)
findings.detail: The Play desktop app is not available in this session, so the badge/webview check named in the CAP-dm-play-runtime verification was not run. The packaged-app boot and the injected-port behavior were exercised by scripts/smoke-boot.mjs and scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs instead.

findings.title: Source-mode store package still ships test helper files
findings.detail: aioson system:package (no --build) only drops *.test.* / *.spec.* files and __tests__/__mocks__/__snapshots__ folders. tests/helpers/testDatabase.ts already appears in the --dry-run list, and tests/e2e/global-setup.ts, tests/e2e/support/fixtures.ts and tests/fixtures/rulesV2.ts will too once they exist. They are small and inert at runtime, so smoke-store-package.mjs asserts the absence of test files (as the packager defines them) rather than of the whole tests/ folder. Excluding the helpers would need a change outside this unit (the packager or a .aioson/build-options-style mechanism).

findings.title: Scratch directory left in the OS temp folder
findings.detail: A throwaway fake-app folder used to prove the smoke-boot mechanics (named fp-scratch-boot.XXXXXX under the OS temp directory; its exact path is in .aioson/runtime/execution-temp/diagnostico-maturidade/8ab9f18d-b196-4f87-b640-79ae0dda3f37/phase-1-backend-package-dev/scratch-boot-path.txt) could not be removed because the delete command was denied in this session. It is outside the project and holds only a few tiny files; it is safe to delete.

messages.text: C-package criterion: `node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs` runs `aioson system:package .`, installs the package twice with `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline` (registry or warm pnpm store required), boots the app twice and deletes the .aioson/system-packages descriptor it created. Give it a generous timeout. It requires server/main.ts, vite.config.ts, src/main.tsx, prisma.config.ts and the other files in REQUIRED_FILES to exist in the package, and it fails if system.json and package.json versions differ (the CLI would rewrite package.json; the script restores it and fails).

RG-boot criterion: `node scripts/smoke-boot.mjs` needs dist/index.html (run `pnpm build` first, otherwise it fails with that message). It uses a throwaway DATABASE_URL, free ports that are not 5173/3301, and expects GET /api/health = 200 with a non-empty body on the backend and through the frontend proxy, and a FitPulse HTML root without 'V-Stage'. If the health route or the page title changes, update checkServing in the script.

scripts/smoke-boot.mjs exports runPnpm, findFreePorts, startApp, stopApp, httpGet, waitUntil, checkServing and assertPortsClosed; its steps only run when executed directly. smoke-store-package.mjs imports them. Keep those export names stable.

system.json mirrors slug fitpulse, name FitPulse, version 0.1.0 and the manifest.json description, with no build_command (source-mode publish). When the release version is bumped, change manifest.json, system.json and package.json together.

evidence.result: FitPulse 0.1.0, 70 files; the list has no data/, no *.db and no package-manager lockfile (the only 'lock' match is prisma/migrations/migration_lock.toml); no .env, aioson-models.json, node_modules, dist or server/generated; tests/ contributes only tests/helpers/testDatabase.ts.

PASS against the real app (server/main.ts had landed from a sibling unit): backend /api/health, UI root and proxied /api/health answered on the injected ports; both ports refused connections on the 3 external IPv4 addresses of this host; ports released after stop. An earlier run before server/main.ts existed failed only on that missing file, as expected.

PASS, 8/8 steps: package of 69 files without data/db/lockfile/tests/secrets, clean pnpm install (generate, migrate, vite build, Inter and JetBrains Mono woff2 in dist/), boot, owner data written, release with a synthetic ALTER TABLE migration laid over the install, second install and boot, companies/diagnoses/drafts/preferences identical afterwards. The .aioson/system-packages descriptor it created was removed.

evidence.command: scratch fake-app run of scripts/smoke-boot.mjs (not part of the project)
evidence.result: Mechanics proof: a fake app listening on 127.0.0.1 passed; the same app listening on 0.0.0.0 made the smoke fail with 'frontend port ... answered on <LAN ip> (connected)'; no fake-app processes were left after the tree kill.
